recovery_history.reason: Gallica SRU previously403. The documented general-catalog SRU alternative has an explicit robots prohibition for OAI-SearchBot.

recovery_history.result: Public API contract identified, but automated OpenAI search access is explicitly disallowed; no live catalog query verified and no script query sent.

recovery.reason: Direct Gallica SRU and general-catalog routes remain restricted, but BnF documents a separate public linked-data endpoint with explicit Gallica reproduction relations.
recovery.attempt: Review primary SPARQL documentation and allowed endpoint policy; bounded metadata seed followed by ten exact literal-title queries. Correct parser to accept the provider legacy typed-literal xsd:string output.
recovery.result: Ten exact-title queries return native Gallica ARKs with BnF edition URIs. Initial legacy typed-string parsing failures retained. No request to restricted SRU/reader/content routes.
